name: Shards of the Felvine
label: Quest
description: Shards of the Felvine: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Your knowledge of Eldre'Thalas - Dire Maul - in Feralas will now come into play, friend. In the eastern part of the ruined city is where Alzzin the Wildshaper has exerted his corrupt dominion. Go there with all due haste and brave whatever challenges await you.
The Fruit of Fertility, now corrupted as the Felvine, should be close to Alzzin. When he falls, capture whatever essence of the Felvine you can. Seal it in the Reliquary, and bring it to me.

clips.title: Progress
paras: With the Sealed Reliquary of Purity in our possession, it will be possible not only to remove a corrupting threat from the world but also to study it under our judicious watch. Perhaps we can even devise new means to combat the taint of corruption that ever threatens Azeroth.
I know Milli would have had it no other way...

clips.title: Completion
paras: It is done, brave adventurer, and with that the Cenarion Circle is in your debt. Though the war is far from over, a great battle has been won against those who would bring about our doom.
Please - accept this as a token of our enduring gratitude. Know that you are welcomed here as a hero of the Cenarion Circle for your great deed, friend. Thank you.
